data.narrative:
Southern Launch is a Growth-stage space & aerospace company founded by Lloyd Damp. The valuation landscape comprises 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, creating a 13-company reference universe. However, both quantitative triangulation methods proved inapplicable to this engagement.

Peer-median analysis failed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage filtered comparables. While 14 same-sector peers exist in the Space & Aerospace universe, none of the narrow cohorts (same-stage Growth companies, adjacent-stage peers, or similar-valuation-tier firms) yielded the minimum three datapoints required for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring could not proceed because Southern Launch's revenue is not on file—a standard constraint with private companies. The public Space & Aerospace sector trades at a median P/S multiple of 24.6x across the 5-ticker reference set, but applying this multiple requires revenue disclosure that is not available.

The absence of applicable quantitative methods means a defensible valuation range cannot be derived from this dataset. Resolution would require either (1) Southern Launch revenue guidance, (2) identification of sufficiently sized private peer funding rounds in the same or adjacent stage with comparable capital structure and market position, or (3) direct comparable transaction data within the narrow launch-services or satellite operations subsector. The current data supports only a statement of method limitation, not a valuation conclusion.
